notDone.why: The front-page capsule (lpHead in scripts/generate-static-pages.ts, a.sg) draws the signature with no credit. A manifest field cannot fix that. The generator must carry provenance.creator/licence/licenseUrl into the capsule for any CC BY image (today only Eco). Alternatively, ship the PD parent File:Umberto-eco001.jpg, which needs a new image file.

The fields proposed here (provenance.shows, captionKo, altKo, creator, licenseUrl) are not yet read. generate-static-pages.ts:368/646 hard-code alt "『…』 초판 표지" and build the edition line from w.firstEdition, and :491-492 group every cover under "초판 표지". The maintainer must switch alt, figcaption and the author-page group label to these fields, and link licenseUrl in the credit. That is a code change outside the manifest.

No replacement files were sourced. The only sourced replacement seen is for Dostoevsky: File:БСЭ1. Автограф. Автографы. 17.svg (Great Soviet Encyclopedia 1st ed., before 1927, {{PD-scan}}). It would need its own crop and manifest row and was not prepared.

Whether each shipped leaf is the cover or the title leaf could not be settled from the NDL/Commons records. The label was narrowed to 초판본/3판본 instead. A colour NDL scan (both NDL records note 同一原本の別画像あり) might settle it.

The drawn credit gets longer in three places: covers/franz-kafka--der-process ("PD" becomes "CC BY 3.0 H.-P. Haack"), covers/franz-kafka--das-schloss ("PD-text" becomes "H.-P.
